'''Chapter 975''' is titled "Kin'emon's Clever Trick".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[["Gang" Bege's Oh My Family]] Vol. 23: "Thank you, whoever you are ♡"

[[Gotti]] realized the woman he saved is in fact [[Charlotte Lola|Lola]].

==Short Summary==
Although the arrival of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], [[Heart Pirates]], and [[Kid Pirates]] was unexpected, the [[Beasts Pirates]] are still confident as they reveal how they prevented the rest of the [[Kouzuki Family]]'s allies from getting to Port Tokage as well as that they had formed an [[Pirate Alliance|alliance]] with the [[Big Mom Pirates]].

However, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] simultaneously attack and destroy one of their ships, and [[Denjiro|Kyoshiro]] arrives on his ship. He attacks another enemy ship, revealing his true identity as Denjiro, and he then reveals that [[Shimotsuki Yasuie|Yasuie]]'s altered message actually instructed the Kouzuki allies to meet at the wharf by Port Habu. Thus, their allies had been able to reach the wharf before [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] destroyed the bridges, and Denjiro had freed the Rasetsu Town prisoners after Orochi had left him in charge of the [[Flower Capital]]. As he reveals this, the alliance, now numbering 5400, arrives at Port Tokage on a massive fleet. Denjiro commends [[Kin'emon]] for cleverly misinforming the other Scabbards to mislead the spy [[Kurozumi Kanjuro|Kanjuro]], unaware that Kin'emon had actually misunderstood the message himself.

==Long Summary==
Although the arrival of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], [[Heart Pirates]], and [[Kid Pirates]] was unexpected, the [[Beasts Pirates]] are still confident as they reveal how they prevented the rest of the [[Kouzuki Family]]'s allies from getting to Tokage Port as well as that they had formed an [[Pirate Alliance|alliance]] with the [[Big Mom Pirates]]. The rookie Pirates are shocked to hear that the two [[Four Emperors|Emperors]] have decided to ally with one another.

However, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] then simultaneously attack and destroy one of their ships.

Soon [[Denjiro|Kyoshiro]] and his family arrives on his ship. The Beasts Pirates believe he is here to aid them in battle and beg him to sink the enemy ships and he proceeds to attack one of the Beast Pirates ships by cutting it in half. Kyoshiro then addresses the Samurai, as Zoro recognizes him from the town.

Ashura Doji believes Kyoshiro might make a bad enemy. However, to the shock of everyone, Kyoshiro then tells the Samurai that his family will aid them in battle.

Kyoshiro speaks to Kin'emon about the Mountain God incident, in which the Capital was nearly destroyed. This shocks Kin'emon, as only one person was aware of this before he realizes who Kyoshiro is and asks if he is Denjiro. Cutting off his pompadour, Kyoshiro reveals his true identity as Denjiro, as his allies are shocked by his new appearance.

Denjiro then reveals that [[Shimotsuki Yasuie|Yasuie]]'s altered message actually instructed the Kouzuki allies to meet at the wharf by Habu Port. Thus, their allies had been able to reach the wharf before [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] destroyed the bridges, and Denjiro had freed the Rasetsu Town prisoners after Orochi had left him in charge of the [[Flower Capital]]. As he reveals this, the alliance, now numbering 5400, arrives at Tokage Port on a massive fleet.

Infuriated that his plans were foiled, Kanjuro curses Kin'emon. Denjiro then commends his friend for fooling the enemy, as Kin'emon takes it in stride, while he internally notes that he had actually misunderstood the message himself.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Shinobu]] is left incapacitated by [[Kurozumi Kanjuro|Kanjuro]] through several snakes binding her down.
*The [[Thousand Sunny]] survived its bombing attempt thanks to the sturdiness of its wood, made from the [[Treasure Tree Adam]].
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] destroy one of the [[Beasts Pirates]]' ships.
**Kid was able to find and retrieve his [[Kid Pirates|crew]].
**They also learn about the [[Pirate Alliance|alliance]] between [[Kaidou]] and [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]].
*[[Denjiro]] destroys a second ship, revealing his allegiance.
**Denjiro reveals his identity to the [[Nine Red Scabbards|Scabbards]] and rejoins them.
*The [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance]] allies join the fight.
**The exact numbers of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance are revealed with more members being added after Denjiro's arrival.
***3,500 former prisoners of the [[Udon]] mines.
***200 [[Yakuza]] members.
***200 members of the [[Inuarashi Musketeer Squad]].
***280 members of the [[Mt. Atama Thieves]].
***200 members of the [[Kyoshiro Family]].
***The 1,000 samurai that were imprisoned at [[Flower Capital#Rasetsu Town|Rasetsu Town]], having been freed by Denjiro.
***The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hat]], [[Heart Pirates|Heart]], and [[Kid Pirates|Kid]] Pirate crews.
****In total, the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance has about 5,400 men.
**The allies are revealed to have been waiting at [[Hakumai#Habu Port|Habu Port]]'s wharf and not [[Udon#Tokage Port|Tokage Port]].
***[[Shimotsuki Yasuie]]'s message changed the meeting point from the port itself to the wharf near the port, rather than changing the port completely.
***It turns out that [[Kin'emon]] misread Yasuie's message, meaning that Kanjuro was accidentally misinformed about the alliance's meeting place.
